findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_product" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Load full details for one product by its `productRef` (from search_products or browse_products): description, price, media, the brand's real product videos, siz…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
